# Calculator

Usage examples (all must hold):

```python
from calculator import add, sub, mul
assert add(2, 3) == 5
assert add(-2, 5) == 3
assert add(40, 2) == 42
assert add(0, 0) == 0
assert sub(5, 2) == 3
assert mul(3, 4) == 12
```
